content.title: 状语从句·六大类连词速查
content.intro: 状语从句在句中作状语,说明主句动作的时间、地点、原因、条件、让步、目的、结果、方式或比较。判断口诀:先看主从句的逻辑关系(什么时候/在哪里/为什么/如果/尽管/为了/以至于/好像/比),再选对应连词。

rows: when/while/as/before/after/until/since/as soon as:I felt excited when the plane took off.
where/wherever:This is the square where artists paint for tourists.
because/since/as:We chose the train because it was cheaper.
if/unless/as long as:We can't see the old town unless we get up early.
though/although/even though/even if:Although she was tired, she went out at once.
so that/in order that:She left early so that she could catch the first train.
so…that / such…that:It was such a long flight that everyone fell asleep.
as if/as though;than:He spoke as if he had lived there. / Flying is faster than the train.

specialRules.rule: so + 形容词/副词 + that 表结果;so that(中间不加形/副)表目的——别混
specialRules.mark: so beautiful that(结果) ｜ so that I could see(目的)

specialRules.rule: such + (a/an) + 形容词 + 名词 + that 表结果
specialRules.mark: such a long flight that everyone slept

specialRules.rule: unless = if … not,本身含否定,从句不再加 not
specialRules.mark: unless you go(=if you don't go)

specialRules.rule: since/as 既可表时间也可表原因,看句意定;though/although 不与 but 连用

why: 状语从句的连词不是靠记搭配硬背,而是看主句和从句之间是'时间先后''因果''假设''转折''目的''结果'还是'比较'——逻辑关系定连词,所以每题往往只有一个连词说得通。
gaokaoPoints: so…that 与 such…that 的区别(看 that 前是形容词还是'a+形+名');so that(目的) vs so…that(结果)。
unless / as long as / even if 在语法填空和完形中高频;though/although 引导让步从句、主句不加 but。
as 的多义(当……时/因为/随着/像……一样)需结合语境判断。

examVsReal.exam: Although it was raining, we still went out.(考试用 Although,主句不加 but)
examVsReal.real: It was raining, but we still went out.
examVsReal.note: 考试常考'although 与 but 不同时用';真实口语里直接用 but 即可

examVsReal.exam: He acted as if he had been there before.(考试用虚拟 had been)
examVsReal.real: He acted like he'd been there before.
examVsReal.note: 考试 as if + 虚拟语气;口语里常用 like 代替 as if,且时态更随意
